The '''E-95 Dread Behemoth''' was a model of [[Hovertank/Legends|hovertank]] produced by during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
The E-95 Dread Behemoth was added to the [[Cartel Market|''Star Wars: The Old Republic'' Cartel Market]] with patch 5.1.0. and is available from the Stalwart Leader Pack.
